passages.text: “You are also to make an altar of acacia wood for the burning of incense.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses instructions for worship.
God told Moses to make an altar.
The altar is for burning incense.
Moses must use acacia wood to make the altar.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ מִזְבֵּ֖חַ מִקְטַ֣ר קְטֹ֑רֶת עֲצֵ֥י שִׁטִּ֖ים תַּעֲשֶׂ֥ה אֹתֽוֹ׃

passages.text: It is to be square, a cubit long, a cubit wide, and two cubits high. Its horns must be of one piece.
passages.sermon:
The altar must be square.
The altar must be one cubit long.
The altar must be one cubit wide.
The altar must be two cubits high.
The horns must be made as one piece with the altar.
passages.original: אַמָּ֨ה אָרְכּ֜וֹ וְאַמָּ֤ה רָחְבּוֹ֙ רָב֣וּעַ יִהְיֶ֔ה וְאַמָּתַ֖יִם קֹמָת֑וֹ מִמֶּ֖נּוּ קַרְנֹתָֽיו׃

passages.text: Overlay with pure gold the top and all the sides and horns, and make a molding of gold around it.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to make an altar for burning incense.
The altar must have a top.
The altar must have sides.
The altar must have horns.
Overlay the top with pure gold.
Overlay all the sides with pure gold.
Overlay the horns with pure gold.
Make a molding of gold around the altar.
passages.original: וְצִפִּיתָ֨ אֹת֜וֹ זָהָ֣ב טָה֗וֹר אֶת־ גַּגּ֧וֹ וְאֶת־ קִירֹתָ֛יו סָבִ֖יב וְאֶת־ קַרְנֹתָ֑יו וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ לּ֛וֹ זֵ֥ר זָהָ֖ב סָבִֽיב׃

passages.text: And make two gold rings below the molding on opposite sides to hold the poles used to carry it.
passages.sermon:
The altar is a square structure.
It is one cubit long and one cubit wide.
It is two cubits high.
Its horns are made from the same piece as the altar.
Overlay the altar with pure gold.
Cover the top, all the sides, and the horns with gold.
Make a gold molding around the altar.
Make two gold rings for the altar.
Place the rings below the gold molding.
Put one ring on each of the two opposite sides.
The rings will hold the poles.
Use the poles to carry the altar.
passages.original: וּשְׁתֵּי֩ טַבְּעֹ֨ת זָהָ֜ב תַּֽעֲשֶׂה־ לּ֣וֹ׀ מִתַּ֣חַת לְזֵר֗וֹ עַ֚ל שְׁתֵּ֣י צַלְעֹתָ֔יו תַּעֲשֶׂ֖ה עַל־ שְׁנֵ֣י צִדָּ֑יו וְהָיָה֙ לְבָתִּ֣ים לְבַדִּ֔ים לָשֵׂ֥את אֹת֖וֹ בָּהֵֽמָּה׃

passages.text: Make the poles of acacia wood and overlay them with gold.
passages.sermon: God gave Moses instructions for building the altar.\r\nMake the poles from acacia wood.\r\nCover the poles with gold.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֥יתָ אֶת־ הַבַּדִּ֖ים עֲצֵ֣י שִׁטִּ֑ים וְצִפִּיתָ֥ אֹתָ֖ם זָהָֽב׃

passages.text: Place the altar in front of the veil that is before the ark of the Testimony —before the mercy seat that is over the Testimony—where I will meet with you.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for the tabernacle.
The altar is a special object for worship.
Place the altar in front of the veil.
The veil stands before the ark of the Testimony.
The ark of the Testimony holds the covenant tablets.
The mercy seat covers the ark of the Testimony.
The altar must stand before the mercy seat.
God will meet with you at this place.
passages.original: וְנָתַתָּ֤ה אֹתוֹ֙ לִפְנֵ֣י הַפָּרֹ֔כֶת אֲשֶׁ֖ר עַל־ אֲרֹ֣ן הָעֵדֻ֑ת לִפְנֵ֣י הַכַּפֹּ֗רֶת אֲשֶׁר֙ עַל־ הָ֣עֵדֻ֔ת אֲשֶׁ֛ר אִוָּעֵ֥ד לְךָ֖ שָֽׁמָּה׃

passages.text: And Aaron is to burn fragrant incense on it every morning when he tends the lamps.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron must burn fragrant incense on the altar.
He must do this every morning.
He must burn the incense when he tends the lamps.
passages.original: וְהִקְטִ֥יר עָלָ֛יו אַהֲרֹ֖ן קְטֹ֣רֶת סַמִּ֑ים בַּבֹּ֣קֶר בַּבֹּ֗קֶר בְּהֵיטִיב֛וֹ אֶת־ הַנֵּרֹ֖ת יַקְטִירֶֽנָּה׃

passages.text: When Aaron sets up the lamps at twilight, he must burn the incense perpetually before the LORD for the generations to come.
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
Aaron must set up the lamps at twilight.
Aaron must burn incense at that time.
Aaron must do this every day.
Aaron must burn incense before the LORD.
Aaron must do this for all generations.
passages.original: וּבְהַעֲלֹ֨ת אַהֲרֹ֧ן אֶת־ הַנֵּרֹ֛ת בֵּ֥ין הָעֲרְבַּ֖יִם יַקְטִירֶ֑נָּה קְטֹ֧רֶת תָּמִ֛יד לִפְנֵ֥י יְהוָ֖ה לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: On this altar you must not offer unauthorized incense or a burnt offering or grain offering; nor are you to pour a drink offering on it.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions for the altar of incense.
This altar is holy.
You must not offer unauthorized incense on this altar.
You must not offer a burnt offering on this altar.
You must not offer a grain offering on this altar.
You must not pour a drink offering on this altar.
passages.original: לֹא־ תַעֲל֥וּ עָלָ֛יו קְטֹ֥רֶת זָרָ֖ה וְעֹלָ֣ה וּמִנְחָ֑ה וְנֵ֕סֶךְ לֹ֥א תִסְּכ֖וּ עָלָֽיו׃

passages.text: Once a year Aaron shall make atonement on the horns of the altar. Throughout your generations he shall make atonement on it annually with the blood of the sin offering of atonement. The altar is most holy to the LORD.”
passages.sermon:
Aaron is the high priest of Israel.
The altar has horns at its corners.
Once every year, Aaron must make atonement on the horns of the altar.
He must use the blood of the sin offering of atonement.
He must do this every year for all your generations.
The altar is most holy to the LORD.
passages.original: וְכִפֶּ֤ר אַהֲרֹן֙ עַל־ קַרְנֹתָ֔יו אַחַ֖ת בַּשָּׁנָ֑ה מִדַּ֞ם חַטַּ֣את הַכִּפֻּרִ֗ים אַחַ֤ת בַּשָּׁנָה֙ יְכַפֵּ֤ר עָלָיו֙ לְדֹרֹ֣תֵיכֶ֔ם קֹֽדֶשׁ־ קָֽדָשִׁ֥ים ה֖וּא לַיהוָֽה׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “When you take a census of the Israelites to number them, each man must pay the LORD a ransom for his life when he is counted. Then no plague will come upon them when they are numbered.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses instructions.
Moses must count the Israelites.
Moses must take a census of the people.
Each man must pay a ransom for his life to the LORD.
Each man must pay when he is counted.
This payment is for the LORD.
If each man pays, no plague will come on them.
No plague will come when they are counted.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ כִּ֣י תִשָּׂ֞א אֶת־ רֹ֥אשׁ בְּנֵֽי־ יִשְׂרָאֵ֘ל לִפְקֻדֵיהֶם֒ וְנָ֨תְנ֜וּ אִ֣ישׁ כֹּ֧פֶר נַפְשׁ֛וֹ לַיהוָ֖ה בִּפְקֹ֣ד אֹתָ֑ם וְלֹא־ יִהְיֶ֥ה בָהֶ֛ם נֶ֖גֶף בִּפְקֹ֥ד אֹתָֽם׃

passages.text: Everyone who crosses over to those counted must pay a half shekel, according to the sanctuary shekel, which weighs twenty gerahs. This half shekel is an offering to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for the Israelites.
God told Moses about a census.
Every man who is counted in the census must give an offering.
Each man must give half a shekel as his offering.
The half shekel must be measured by the sanctuary shekel.
The sanctuary shekel weighs twenty gerahs.
The half shekel is an offering to the LORD.
passages.original: זֶ֣ה׀ יִתְּנ֗וּ כָּל־ הָעֹבֵר֙ עַל־ הַפְּקֻדִ֔ים מַחֲצִ֥ית הַשֶּׁ֖קֶל בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ עֶשְׂרִ֤ים גֵּרָה֙ הַשֶּׁ֔קֶל מַחֲצִ֣ית הַשֶּׁ֔קֶל תְּרוּמָ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Everyone twenty years of age or older who crosses over must give this offering to the LORD.
passages.sermon: Every Israelite who is counted in the census must give an offering to the LORD.\r\nEach person must be at least twenty years old.\r\nOnly those who are twenty years old or older must give this offering.
passages.original: כֹּ֗ל הָעֹבֵר֙ עַל־ הַפְּקֻדִ֔ים מִבֶּ֛ן עֶשְׂרִ֥ים שָׁנָ֖ה וָמָ֑עְלָה יִתֵּ֖ן תְּרוּמַ֥ת יְהוָֽה׃

passages.text: In making the offering to the LORD to atone for your lives, the rich shall not give more than a half shekel, nor shall the poor give less.
passages.sermon:
God gave a command to the Israelites.
Each person must give an offering to the LORD.
This offering is to atone for their lives.
The offering is a half shekel.
The rich person must not give more than a half shekel.
The poor person must not give less than a half shekel.
passages.original: הֶֽעָשִׁ֣יר לֹֽא־ יַרְבֶּ֗ה וְהַדַּל֙ לֹ֣א יַמְעִ֔יט מִֽמַּחֲצִ֖ית הַשָּׁ֑קֶל לָתֵת֙ אֶת־ תְּרוּמַ֣ת יְהוָ֔ה לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־ נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Take the atonement money from the Israelites and use it for the service of the Tent of Meeting. It will serve as a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD to make atonement for your lives.”
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses instructions for the Israelites.
Moses must take the atonement money from the Israelites.
This money comes from every Israelite who is twenty years old or older.
Moses must use this money for the service of the Tent of Meeting.
The Tent of Meeting is the place where God meets with His people.
This money will serve as a memorial for the Israelites before the LORD.
This memorial will remind the Israelites of their atonement before God.
This atonement money makes atonement for the lives of the Israelites.
passages.original: וְלָקַחְתָּ֞ אֶת־ כֶּ֣סֶף הַכִּפֻּרִ֗ים מֵאֵת֙ בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֔ל וְנָתַתָּ֣ אֹת֔וֹ עַל־ עֲבֹדַ֖ת אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְהָיָה֩ לִבְנֵ֨י יִשְׂרָאֵ֤ל לְזִכָּרוֹן֙ לִפְנֵ֣י יְהוָ֔ה לְכַפֵּ֖ר עַל־ נַפְשֹׁתֵיכֶֽם׃פ

passages.text: And the LORD said to Moses, “You are to make a bronze basin with a bronze stand for washing. Set it between the Tent of Meeting and the altar, and put water in it, with which Aaron and his sons are to wash their hands and feet.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses instructions.
Moses must make a basin.
The basin must be made of bronze.
Moses must also make a stand for the basin.
The stand must be made of bronze.
The basin is for washing.
Moses must place the basin between the Tent of Meeting and the altar.
Moses must put water in the basin.
Aaron and his sons must use the water from the basin.
Aaron and his sons must wash their hands and their feet with the water.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ וְעָשִׂ֜יתָ כִּיּ֥וֹר נְחֹ֛שֶׁת וְכַנּ֥וֹ נְחֹ֖שֶׁת לְרָחְצָ֑ה וְנָתַתָּ֣ אֹת֗וֹ בֵּֽין־ אֹ֤הֶל מוֹעֵד֙ וּבֵ֣ין הַמִּזְבֵּ֔חַ וְנָתַתָּ֥ שָׁ֖מָּה מָֽיִם׃ וְרָחֲצ֛וּ אַהֲרֹ֥ן וּבָנָ֖יו מִמֶּ֑נּוּ אֶת־ יְדֵיהֶ֖ם וְאֶת־ רַגְלֵיהֶֽם׃

passages.text: Whenever they enter the Tent of Meeting or approach the altar to minister by presenting an offering made by fire to the LORD, they must wash with water so that they will not die.
passages.sermon:
Aaron and his sons are priests of Israel.
They serve God in the Tent of Meeting and at the altar.
When they enter the Tent of Meeting, they must wash with water.
When they approach the altar to serve, they must wash with water.
They present offerings made by fire to the LORD at the altar.
If they do not wash with water, they will die.
passages.original: בְּבֹאָ֞ם אֶל־ אֹ֧הֶל מוֹעֵ֛ד יִרְחֲצוּ־ מַ֖יִם וְלֹ֣א יָמֻ֑תוּ א֣וֹ בְגִשְׁתָּ֤ם אֶל־ הַמִּזְבֵּ֙חַ֙ לְשָׁרֵ֔ת לְהַקְטִ֥יר אִשֶּׁ֖ה לַֽיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Thus they are to wash their hands and feet so that they will not die; this shall be a permanent statute for Aaron and his descendants for the generations to come.”
passages.sermon:
God gave Moses instructions for Aaron and his sons.
Aaron and his sons must wash their hands and feet.
They must do this so they will not die.
This rule will last forever.
This rule is for Aaron and his descendants.
This rule will continue for all their generations.
passages.original: וְרָחֲצ֛וּ יְדֵיהֶ֥ם וְרַגְלֵיהֶ֖ם וְלֹ֣א יָמֻ֑תוּ וְהָיְתָ֨ה לָהֶ֧ם חָק־ עוֹלָ֛ם ל֥וֹ וּלְזַרְע֖וֹ לְדֹרֹתָֽם׃פ

passages.text: Then the LORD said to Moses, “Take the finest spices: 500 shekels of liquid myrrh, half that amount (250 shekels) of fragrant cinnamon, 250 shekels of fragrant cane, 500 shekels of cassia —all according to the sanctuary shekel—and a hin of olive oil.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses instructions.
The LORD told Moses to take the finest spices.
Moses must take 500 shekels of liquid myrrh.
Moses must take 250 shekels of fragrant cinnamon.
Moses must take 250 shekels of fragrant cane.
Moses must take 500 shekels of cassia.
Moses must measure all these spices by the sanctuary shekel.
Moses must also take a hin of olive oil.
passages.original: וַיְדַבֵּ֥ר יְהוָ֖ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֥ה לֵּאמֹֽר׃ וְאַתָּ֣ה קַח־ לְךָ֮ בְּשָׂמִ֣ים רֹאשׁ֒ מָר־ דְּרוֹר֙ חֲמֵ֣שׁ מֵא֔וֹת וְקִנְּמָן־ בֶּ֥שֶׂם מַחֲצִית֖וֹ חֲמִשִּׁ֣ים וּמָאתָ֑יִם וּקְנֵה־ בֹ֖שֶׂם חֲמִשִּׁ֥ים וּמָאתָֽיִם׃ וְקִדָּ֕ה חֲמֵ֥שׁ מֵא֖וֹת בְּשֶׁ֣קֶל הַקֹּ֑דֶשׁ וְשֶׁ֥מֶן זַ֖יִת הִֽין׃

passages.text: Prepare from these a sacred anointing oil, a fragrant blend, the work of a perfumer; it will be a sacred anointing oil.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses instructions.
God told Moses to make a sacred anointing oil.
Moses must use the finest spices and olive oil.
Moses must blend these ingredients together.
A skilled perfumer must prepare the blend.
The oil must have a special fragrance.
This oil will be a sacred anointing oil.
passages.original: וְעָשִׂ֣יתָ אֹת֗וֹ שֶׁ֚מֶן מִשְׁחַת־ קֹ֔דֶשׁ רֹ֥קַח מִרְקַ֖חַת מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רֹקֵ֑חַ שֶׁ֥מֶן מִשְׁחַת־ קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶֽה׃

passages.text: Use this oil to anoint the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the Testimony, the table and all its utensils, the lampstand and its utensils, the altar of incense, the altar of burnt offering and all its utensils, and the basin with its stand.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses instructions.
God told Moses to use the sacred anointing oil.
Moses must anoint the Tent of Meeting with this oil.
Moses must anoint the ark of the Testimony with this oil.
Moses must anoint the table with this oil.
Moses must anoint all the table’s utensils with this oil.
Moses must anoint the lampstand with this oil.
Moses must anoint all the lampstand’s utensils with this oil.
Moses must anoint the altar of incense with this oil.
Moses must anoint the altar of burnt offering with this oil.
Moses must anoint all the altar’s utensils with this oil.
Moses must anoint the basin with this oil.
Moses must anoint the basin’s stand with this oil.
passages.original: וּמָשַׁחְתָּ֥ ב֖וֹ אֶת־ אֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֑ד וְאֵ֖ת אֲר֥וֹן הָעֵדֻֽת׃ וְאֶת־ הַשֻּׁלְחָן֙ וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֔יו וְאֶת־ הַמְּנֹרָ֖ה וְאֶת־ כֵּלֶ֑יהָ וְאֵ֖ת מִזְבַּ֥ח הַקְּטֹֽרֶת׃ וְאֶת־ מִזְבַּ֥ח הָעֹלָ֖ה וְאֶת־ כָּל־ כֵּלָ֑יו וְאֶת־ הַכִּיֹּ֖ר וְאֶת־ כַּנּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: You are to consecrate them so that they will be most holy. Whatever touches them shall be holy.
passages.sermon:
God commanded Moses to consecrate the holy objects.
These objects include the Tent of Meeting and its furnishings.
Moses must set them apart for God.
These objects will become most holy.
Anything that touches these holy objects will also become holy.
passages.original: וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֣ אֹתָ֔ם וְהָי֖וּ קֹ֣דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֑ים כָּל־ הַנֹּגֵ֥עַ בָּהֶ֖ם יִקְדָּֽשׁ׃

passages.text: Anoint Aaron and his sons and consecrate them to serve Me as priests.
passages.sermon:
God chose Aaron and his sons.
God commanded Moses to anoint Aaron and his sons with oil.
God told Moses to consecrate Aaron and his sons.
Aaron and his sons would serve God as priests.
passages.original: וְאֶת־ אַהֲרֹ֥ן וְאֶת־ בָּנָ֖יו תִּמְשָׁ֑ח וְקִדַּשְׁתָּ֥ אֹתָ֖ם לְכַהֵ֥ן לִֽי׃

passages.text: And you are to tell the Israelites, ‘This will be My sacred anointing oil for the generations to come.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses a command.
God told Moses to speak to the Israelites.
God said, “This oil is My sacred anointing oil.
This oil belongs to Me.
This oil will be holy for you.
This oil will be for all your generations.”
passages.original: וְאֶל־ בְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵ֖ל תְּדַבֵּ֣ר לֵאמֹ֑ר שֶׁ֠מֶן מִשְׁחַת־ קֹ֨דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֥ה זֶ֛ה לִ֖י לְדֹרֹתֵיכֶֽם׃

passages.text: It must not be used to anoint an ordinary man, and you must not make anything like it with the same formula. It is holy, and it must be holy to you.
passages.sermon:
God gave instructions about the sacred anointing oil.
This oil is holy.
Do not put this oil on any ordinary person.
Do not make any oil like it using the same recipe.
This oil is set apart for God.
It must be holy to you.
passages.original: עַל־ בְּשַׂ֤ר אָדָם֙ לֹ֣א יִיסָ֔ךְ וּבְמַ֨תְכֻּנְתּ֔וֹ לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ כָּמֹ֑הוּ קֹ֣דֶשׁ ה֔וּא קֹ֖דֶשׁ יִהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: Anyone who mixes perfume like it or puts it on an outsider shall be cut off from his people.’ ”
passages.sermon:
God gave a command to the Israelites.
God spoke about the sacred anointing oil.
Anyone who makes oil like this oil breaks God’s command.
Anyone who puts this oil on someone who is not allowed breaks God’s command.
God will cut off that person from his people.
passages.original: אִ֚ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֣ר יִרְקַ֣ח כָּמֹ֔הוּ וַאֲשֶׁ֥ר יִתֵּ֛ן מִמֶּ֖נּוּ עַל־ זָ֑ר וְנִכְרַ֖ת מֵעַמָּֽיו׃ס

passages.text: The LORD also said to Moses, “Take fragrant spices—gum resin, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense—in equal measures, and make a fragrant blend of incense, the work of a perfumer, seasoned with salt, pure and holy.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses instructions.
The LORD told Moses to take fragrant spices.
These spices are gum resin, onycha, galbanum, and pure frankincense.
Moses must take equal amounts of each spice.
Moses must make a blend of incense from these spices.
A perfumer must prepare this incense.
The incense must be seasoned with salt.
The incense must be pure.
The incense must be holy.
passages.original: וַיֹּאמֶר֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֶל־ מֹשֶׁ֜ה קַח־ לְךָ֣ סַמִּ֗ים נָטָ֤ף׀ וּשְׁחֵ֙לֶת֙ וְחֶלְבְּנָ֔ה סַמִּ֖ים וּלְבֹנָ֣ה זַכָּ֑ה בַּ֥ד בְּבַ֖ד יִהְיֶֽה׃ וְעָשִׂ֤יתָ אֹתָהּ֙ קְטֹ֔רֶת רֹ֖קַח מַעֲשֵׂ֣ה רוֹקֵ֑חַ מְמֻלָּ֖ח טָה֥וֹר קֹֽדֶשׁ׃

passages.text: Grind some of it into fine powder and place it in front of the Testimony in the Tent of Meeting, where I will meet with you. It shall be most holy to you.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Moses.
God gave Moses instructions about holy incense.
God told Moses to grind some of the incense into fine powder.
God told Moses to place this powder in front of the Testimony.
The Testimony was inside the Tent of Meeting.
God said He would meet with Moses there.
God said this incense must be most holy to the people.
passages.original: וְשָֽׁחַקְתָּ֣ מִמֶּנָּה֮ הָדֵק֒ וְנָתַתָּ֨ה מִמֶּ֜נָּה לִפְנֵ֤י הָעֵדֻת֙ בְּאֹ֣הֶל מוֹעֵ֔ד אֲשֶׁ֛ר אִוָּעֵ֥ד לְךָ֖ שָׁ֑מָּה קֹ֥דֶשׁ קָֽדָשִׁ֖ים תִּהְיֶ֥ה לָכֶֽם׃

passages.text: You are never to use this formula to make incense for yourselves; you shall regard it as holy to the LORD.
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Moses.
The LORD gave Moses instructions about incense.
The LORD said, "Do not make incense for yourselves using this formula.
This incense is holy.
This incense belongs to the LORD.
Treat this incense as holy to the LORD."
passages.original: וְהַקְּטֹ֙רֶת֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תַּעֲשֶׂ֔ה בְּמַ֨תְכֻּנְתָּ֔הּ לֹ֥א תַעֲשׂ֖וּ לָכֶ֑ם קֹ֛דֶשׁ תִּהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֖ לַיהוָֽה׃

passages.text: Anyone who makes something like it to enjoy its fragrance shall be cut off from his people.”
passages.sermon:
God gave Israel a special incense formula.
This incense is holy.
No one may copy this incense for personal use.
If a person makes incense like it to smell its fragrance,
God will cut that person off from his people.
passages.original: אִ֛ישׁ אֲשֶׁר־ יַעֲשֶׂ֥ה כָמ֖וֹהָ לְהָרִ֣יחַ בָּ֑הּ וְנִכְרַ֖ת מֵעַמָּֽיו׃ס
